Description.Name: The Hard Numbers
Description.Details:
<color=#BFBFBF>Farah's already got the projector going by the time you walk into the conference room, a wireframe schematic of the half-built hangar rotating slowly above the table.</color> "Commander. I have finished my study of the work that has been done so far."

<color=#BFBFBF>She flicks through readouts without looking up.</color> "Good news is the structural bones really are good. Bad news is the deck and Mech bays aren't. Every load bearing beam down there needs reinforcement before I'll sign off on putting a dozen Mechs anywhere near it. I'm talking a full metric ton of naval-grade Ferro-Aluminum, minimum, worked into the support structure before we touch anything else."

<color=#BFBFBF>Darius whistles low.</color> "A ton. That's not exactly something you pick up at the corner store."

"No, it is not." <color=#BFBFBF>Farah says flatly.</color> "That grade of Ferro-Aluminum is built for capital ship hulls, not BattleMechs. It does not move through our normal supply channels, and our less legal contacts will not have that amount available."

<color=#BFBFBF>Sumire, leaning in over the table, speaks up.</color> "Then we look at less conventional means of acquisition."

<color=#BFBFBF>Darius raises an eyebrow.</color> "Less conventional meaning what, exactly. Ripping it out of somebody else's cargo hold?"

"More or less." <color=#BFBFBF>Sumire's expression doesn't change.</color> "Material like that ships in bulk on transport Mechs and cargo haulers. Hit the right convoy, and it falls into our lap instead of costing us a single C-bill."

<color=#BFBFBF>Farah swipes to the next readout, unbothered by the detour.</color> "Beyond the structure, the bay needs a full electronics fit as well. Several hundred meters of advanced cabling and conduit, new sensor arrays for the bay itself, data links back to the main hangar network, and a proper communications suite so the deck isn't running blind. That part is comparatively simple. Any system with a developed electronics industry should stock what we need."

<color=#BFBFBF>Yang speaks up while leaning against the doorway, arms crossed.</color> "And even once we've got the material, none of my people are free to actually install it, even if we could. We're a combat crew, not a shipyard crew."

"He's right." <color=#BFBFBF>Farah nods.</color> "This needs experienced hands. I would estimate a dozen qualified workers, and a project timeline of up to four months once materials are on hand."

<color=#BFBFBF>Yang shrugs.</color> "Good news is that kind of crew isn't hard to find, not if we go looking in the right places. Any system that's actually building things ought to have people who know one end of a rivet gun from the other."

<color=#BFBFBF>Farah closes the projection.</color> "So. A ton of naval-grade material we cannot buy outright, a full electronics fit we can, and a construction crew we will need to hire. It will not be free, nor will it be quick, but definitely doable."

<color=#BFBFBF>She looks at you directly.</color> "So what do you think, Commander?"

Description.Name: [Order everyone to start looking for the materials]

Description.Name: Start the Search
Description.Details: You look over the schematic one more time, then nod. "Let's do it. Get me that material, get me that crew, and let's put this hangar to actual use." Farah is already keying notes into her datapad. "I will flag the requirements for the crew." Yang grins and claps his hands together once. "Now we're talking. I'll start putting feelers out for people who know what they're doing." [The naval-grade [[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_FerroAluminum],Ferro-Aluminum]] needed for the hangar's structure can only be recovered from the cargo containers of IndustrialMechs or cargo vehicles. Salvage from Ambush Convoy contracts offers the best chance of finding such containers. The [[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_CablesAndDataLinks],Cables and Data Links]], [[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_CableConduits],Cable Conduits]], [[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_SensorsAndProbes],Sensors and Probes]], and [[DM.UpgradeDefs[ConstructionMaterials_CommunicationsEquipment],Communications Equipment]] needed to outfit the hangar can appear in the system store of any star system with the Electronics attribute. You only need to buy each item once. Once all the materials have been gathered the construction crew can be hired by remaining in port at a star system with the Manufacturing attribute once the materials are gathered. This may take some time to trigger.
